title: mesh-bus-egress-service
description: Config for local service-sink egresses (native direct reverse stream/datagram). Constructed by mesh-bus-runtime from EgressCfg::ServiceTcp and EgressCfg::ServiceUdp.

id.description: Unique ExitId for this service sink within the bus.

service_id.description: Static service identity label exposed to observation. Never derived from payload.

route_group.description: Optional route_group this service sink advertises (compatibility alias for a single-group membership).

groups.description: route_group filter membership. A session whose route_group is Some(g) reaches this sink only if g is in groups.

connect.description: Local TCP or UDP endpoint the service listens on, such as 127.0.0.1:8080 or 127.0.0.1:53. The data plane dials/sends to this; request.target is service-intent metadata only.

timeout_ms.description: Connect and write timeout in milliseconds.

supports_stream.description: ServiceTcp supports stream only; ServiceUdp supports datagram only.

supports_datagram.description: ServiceTcp supports stream only; ServiceUdp supports datagram only.
